question: What digital services does iWAAt specialize in?
answer: iWAAt is a full-service digital agency. We specialize in custom Web Development, Software Engineering, UI/UX Design, Branding & Visual Identity, SEO & Digital Marketing, and Ongoing Maintenance & Support. Whether you need a healthcare platform, NGO portal, photography website, gym app, or e-commerce store, we deliver end-to-end solutions.

question: How long does a typical web development project take?
answer: Project timelines depend on scope and complexity. Standard business websites and landing pages typically take 2-4 weeks, while complex web applications, custom CRM tools, or multi-functional healthcare/NGO portals take 6-10 weeks from discovery to production launch.

question: Do you provide website maintenance after the project launches?
answer: Yes! We offer dedicated maintenance and support packages that cover 24/7 technical assistance, continuous security updates, server monitoring, Core Web Vitals speed optimization, content updates, and monthly growth analytics.

question: Are all iWAAt websites mobile-responsive and SEO-optimized?
answer: Absolutely. Every digital experience we engineer is 100% mobile-first responsive across all screen sizes (320px to 4K ultrawide) and built with clean semantic HTML, schema markup, high speed performance, and technical SEO best practices out of the box.

question: Can iWAAt redesign an existing outdated website?
answer: Yes, we specialize in complete visual and technical redesigns. We perform a thorough audit of your current site, preserve your existing SEO rankings, and craft a modern, high-converting React/Vite web application.

question: What is the typical engagement model and budget range?
answer: We work with fixed-price project contracts as well as monthly dedicated retainer models for enterprise and growing startups. We tailor our proposals to fit your specific scope and ROI goals.

question: How do we get started with a new project?
answer: Getting started is simple! You can fill out our interactive contact form, send us an email at hello@iwaat.com, or schedule a direct consultation call. We will review your requirements and deliver a comprehensive proposal within 24 hours.
